notes.title: Complete Redesign of the First Chapter
notes.content:
Hi there,

In this update, I want to present you a complete redesign of the First Chapter.


* The main character is completely redesigned and changed. Removed torch animation. Instead, added inventory and battle systems (and smoother battle animations). The character can wear: a diadem, a bra, a shield, a sword and a mace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596013/f844cc17307b721c226e01a35f832430a9baca60.png

* Two types of enemy are added, these are skeletons with melee and ranged.

* Changed lighting.

* In addition to existing paintings with painted nude 2D girls, 3D paintings were added.

* Tooltips improved.

* Completely redesigned menu. Added more settings.

* Added an additional female character. In the dungeon at the lower level, you can have sexual intercourse with her.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596013/edac1a0ad691aa203d22be720877f9d0bda39b5e.png

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Hi there.

After almost 3 months the game is ready for full release.

During this time:
the first chapter was fully completed.
Made two large and three small locations for the second chapter.
Added 7 characters. 4 of which are enemies.
In addition to the 20 arts, 15+ were added.
Simplified combat system.
Replaced or improved some of the main character animations.
Improved lighting
As well as a lot of minor or small innovations or changes.
Some minor bugs that will be detected soon will be fixed.

In honor of the release during the week will be a discount of 40%. 
The price will remain the same. It will not rise.

notes.title: Update - II Chapter (19.06.2019)
notes.content:
Hey.

Almost 3 weeks have passed since the last update. During this time, three small unannounced updates were released. In them fixed and gradually added new content.

In the current update:

Added two new game characters. (In the future, you can play for one of them).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34596013/3df7d0cafe40a456427856c47969fba9356b4288.png

Added a small tavern on the first floor, only through one door you can get into it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34596013/aa8dbee394d75d957e945f26309fac2b5abb9bef.png

Added new animations (without using weapons)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34596013/5dda8d97edcddeca8c314c14362deda66ebc8358.png

notes.title: Update (01.05.19)
notes.content:
Added jump animation (will be adjusted).
 Added tooltips (Two tips are mixed up in places, which is why there will be a wrong text with a hint, it will be fixed).
 Added the ability to delete all widgets (pictures, notes).
 Added a picture with loli.
 The optimization work was carried out.


(Spanish, French and Italian languages have been added (but at the moment they are not always reproduced due to the font, it will be fixed).

notes.title: Update (28.04.19)
notes.content:
Last update before release:


 Added 7 achievements, in the future their number will be increased to 20.
 Two languages ​​have been added, namely German and Japanese (there may be problems with the translation of some words, this will be fixed).
 Half-empty rooms are furnished with models.
 In addition to running added the ability to walk normally.
 Particles have been added, and light effects have been added for some rooms.

notes.title: Update (24.04.19)
notes.content:
Hey. The game will be released within 7 days. While the game was waiting for approval, it was done:
Chinese and Russian languages ​​have been added, and Japanese, German, French, Italian and Spanish will be added in the near future.
Added dialogue system.
Notes have been added for each location.
Added the ability to use a torch.
Added voices to characters.
The optimization work was carried out.
